name: 原初·法杖·T2·戒指
prompt:
EXACT PRIMARY T2 JEWELLERY SHAPE: one wearable finger ring with a TALL NARROW RECTANGULAR open top cradle, two upright rails surrounding one restrained rhombus core. Clearly open finger hole. One upright two-rail setting defines the intermediate contour, not a simple diamond slab or a three-pronged crown.
Create ONE standalone transparent production equipment icon, gear-primal-staff-t2-ring. Follow the exact object shape above. Physical series materials: warm IVORY BONE and WALNUT ROOTWOOD as the actual functional construction, tan wraps, one restrained amber accent. No conventional polished steel body. Family palette/identity: deep warm wood, muted cyan, ivory and brass; tall narrow rhombi, vertical structures and open forked supports. Style: simple chunky rounded chibi adventure item, warm soft dark outline, matte TWO OR THREE broad shading planes, restrained warm highlights, readable at 32/48px. Match references for drawing style ONLY, do not copy their shapes. One complete empty wearable or weapon; boots may be a compact pair. Centre on a square transparent canvas, longest extent 80%, full object and equal safety margins. No person, background, floor, external shadow, frames, labels, numbers, dense tiny detail, glowing aura or sprite sheet. True transparent alpha.
normalization: alpha crop and proportional Lanczos inside 208px, centred on transparent 256px canvas
reviewNote: Final 32/48px comparison reads as ordinary cloth or a standard-family recolour. Regenerate with physical stone or bone/rootwood construction and the selected series core colour.
